meta.name: what-the
meta.description: What the? Use when the user wants a plain-English breakdown of something technical — the who, what, where, why, and when.

copy.tagline: 用大白话解释任何技术概念
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常需要向非技术人员解释技术概念
copy.tagline_en: Explain any technical concept in plain English
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to explain technical concepts to non-technical people

howto.what: 当用户要求把某个技术内容用通俗易懂的语言解释时,Claude 会按是谁、是什么、在哪、为什么、何时这五个方面来拆解说明。
howto.when: 当用户想弄懂某个技术术语或概念,明确要求用大白话讲清楚,并涉及 who、what、where、why、when 时触发。

say.text: What the? 给我讲讲区块链,用简单的话说清楚五个 W。
say.note: 这是该技能的惯用开场。

say.text: 这个技术名词我不懂,帮我用日常语言说说它是什么、谁在用、为什么用。
say.note: 会得到通俗版五 W 说明。

howto.what_en: When the user asks for a plain-English explanation of something technical, Claude breaks it down into the who, what, where, why, and when.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user wants a technical term or concept explained in simple language, covering the five W's.

say_en.text: Explain what an API is in plain English, covering who, what, where, why, and when.
say_en.note: You'll get a plain breakdown by the five W's.

say_en.text: What the? Tell me about blockchain in simple terms — the five W's.
say_en.note: This is the usual entry phrase.

say_en.text: I don't get this technical term. Use everyday language: what it is, who uses it, and why.
say_en.note: You'll get a plain-language five-W explanation.
